    - heading "Welcome to Fugro!" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "\"We are committed to providing a healthy, safe and secure workplace for all our people. At Fugro, Safety is more than just a requirement for us; it's a fundamental part of how we operate. And thanks to our safety standards, our teams are protected at sea, on land, and at all our facilities.\""
    - img "Erwin Hoogeveen - Dec 2024.jpg"
    - paragraph: Erwin Hoogeveen
    - paragraph: Group Director Human Resources
    - paragraph: We're always looking for bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further.
    - heading "What makes us Fugro" [level=2]
    - link "Why join us":
      - /url: /careers/working-at-fugro
      - text: Why join us
      - img
    - img "FACES OF FUGRO.00_00_50_22.Still030.jpg"
    - paragraph: "01"
    - heading "Freedom to grow faster" [level=2]
    - paragraph: In our business, you sometimes need to grab bulls by their horns. If you’re open to taking the initiative, big opportunities await you at Fugro. And while we believe that you’re responsible for your own career, we’ll actively support you to further develop yourself.
    - img "FACES OF FUGRO.00_01_18_12.Still028.jpg"
    - paragraph: "02"
    - heading "Focused on teamwork" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Individuals can achieve good things, but it’s true that there’s strength in numbers. In our experience, working together makes us stronger and better placed to find the best solutions for our clients. So you can expect to work in great teams with capable, open-minded people like yourself.
    - img "FACES OF FUGRO.00_05_52_11.Still024.jpg"
    - paragraph: "03"
    - heading "International Geo-data environment" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We work around the world, which means you can too. But wherever your role with us takes you, our inclusive culture remains the same. That goes for our curiosity too: we may know the earth well now, but our people are always keen to learn more."
    - img "FACES OF FUGRO.00_09_31_16.Still064.jpg"
    - paragraph: "04"
    - heading "Reliable employer" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Fugro is a people business built on trust. We’re committed to being an employer you can depend on, just as we need to be able to rely on you. So honesty and responsibility are important, especially when it comes to the vital goal of a safe working environment (for minds and bodies alike).
    - img "FACES OF FUGRO.00_06_26_14.Still050.jpg"
    - paragraph: "05"
    - heading "Challenging projects, exciting opportunities" [level=2]
    - paragraph: We always find ourselves ahead of the curve. It’s why we can offer the best projects to test yourself on. To stay out in front we continually adapt and enhance the way we work, from everyday processes to breakthrough operations. Which keeps the stimulating assignments coming.
    - img "FACES OF FUGRO.00_03_16_11.Still016.jpg"
    - paragraph: "06"
    - heading "Be whoever you want to be" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Actors need not apply, because you can be yourself here. We encourage our people to bring their enthusiasm and a bit of their own personality to dealings with colleagues and clients. We also know that diversity gives us strength in depth, including the different perspectives that help us to excel together.
    - img "lane4.jpg"
    - paragraph: Employee story
    - heading "Lane, Geophysical Operator" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "\"I largely view it the same as my touring days. You don't have the crowd, the adulation and the band. But on our view, when we pull on the location and deploy the gear, that's the show! We load in, we do the show, we load out and move on to another site.\""
    - paragraph: Employee story
    - heading "Melanie, Senior Geotechnical Engineer" [level=2]
    - paragraph: “Treating the land respectfully means not leaving any lasting damage, not affecting the environment and the wildlife negatively. We investigate how to build safe and efficient, ensuring not only effectiveness but also longevity throughout the lifespan of the built structure.”
    - paragraph: Employee story
    - heading "Ben, Site Manager - Fugro Orca" [level=2]
    - paragraph: “For me it's the fact that we can control an ROV remotely, while it is connected to a vessel with no one on board. Everything is controlled remotely. That's new tech, new equipment. It’s exciting!”
    - paragraph: Employee story
    - heading "Paige, Remote Operations Surveyor" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "“We are very diverse in the jobs that we do: From land to offshore, to being in the air! This gives you opportunity to grow as well.\""
    - link "Read more":
      - /url: /careers/stories/lane-geophysical-operator
      - text: Read more
